metric: Mean final-fitness rank; lower is better

group_definitions.DDCPO-I: Hybrid Chebyshev-Tent initialization replaced by uniform random initialization.
group_definitions.DDCPO-W: Nonlinear oscillatory search weight replaced by the constant 0.75; candidate-update operations retained.

rank_method: Sort ascending fitness and average rank positions within 1e-10 of the first value in a tie group.
bootstrap_method: Resample complete matched four-group pairs within each map; keep the original number of pairs per map; average five map means.
bootstrap_ci_quantile_rule: Percentile intervals using interpolation at index 1+(B-1)*p.
failed_run_handling: All four-group records, including recorded penalties and unsuccessful runs, are retained.
preparation: Existing recorded values were selected and saved. Ranks, means, confidence intervals, experiments, and bootstrap samples were not recomputed during data-package preparation.
